The proposal adds one passive controller check for two local post-resume stages. The complete accepted adapter6482b782 remains the first28,922 bytes; 98 appended lines define _validate_controller_worker_stage(startup, permit, session, worker, stage) and its locked helper.

Both stages require the exact consumed startup/session and retained authority snapshots, active lease/permit/reservation/protection, WORKER_BOUND with no pending or failed persistence, no revocation, and resume_attempted=True. The same non-None worker must be in token.worker and the actual _DurableKernel._starts[permit.identity]. finish_start requires NATIVE_RESERVED and session._worker=None. published requires NATIVE_RUNNING and that exact session._worker. Checks use manager-then-reservation locks and the existing captured pure authority helpers; they call no lower service or supplied callback and return the existing startup object, not a new witness.

The new WorkerStageFixture subclasses the unchanged isolated StartupFixture. Its lower create hook consumes the factory-issued session and calls the inherited inert Kernel.create_suspended. The unchanged durable kernel then retains, binds and resumes the returned worker, calls the fixed finish hook, and the actual factory publishes it. The hook observes finish_start before publication. Normal completion uses actual close_and_join and lease.confirm_native_closed; errors cross the actual lease context with retained custody.

Fourteen proposed controls cover both real local transitions, refused labels and state pairs, unbound workers, copied authority, worker-binding substitutions, configuration/value changes, active-lease constraints, actual reservation revocation, close/reuse, a finish failure plus failed exact-stop, and lease exit during finish. EXPECTED-CASES.json lists their ordered IDs. None has run. Existing accepted test files were not edited; their copied inputs remain byte-identical.

The existing isolated startup_fixture_resolver/startup_fixture_adapter loading contract applies. Only the isolated adapter uses the appended source; canonical adapter/resolver authorities stay absent. Load worker_stage_fixture and test_controller_worker_stage after the existing fixture and shared lifecycle modules. The new append imports _DurableKernel from the already required durable_lifecycle module. No qualifier or admission is provided.

This unit does not establish Windows resume, assigned-job/native read-set ownership, pipe/source authentication, child namespace issuance, model construction or release approval. The resume flag is a local attempt record. All public real-entry refusals and real authority defaults remain unchanged. The failed child connection is not a source input.

Only source-text preparation and passive byte/diff checks occurred. Before copies, exact differences, source bindings and actual tool objects are retained here. No Python startup/import/compile/test, native/model/support/artifact access, physical journal read, network or Git operation occurred.

This fresh proposal derives accepted adapter6482b782 and preserves its entire28,922-byte prefix. It does not use failed adapter65a0715e or the rejected child coordinator/fixture.
